$comment: Exceptions for the package guard (scripts/Test-PackageHygiene.ps1). Each entry allows CPM bypasses in files matching 'path' (glob: * and ? stay in one folder, ** crosses folders). 'condition' is optional; when set, the bypass must sit under exactly that MSBuild Condition. 'reason' is mandatory: say why the exception exists and when it can go. The guard warns about entries that no longer match anything.

cpmBypass.reason: The Azure Functions isolated worker SDK generates a hidden WorkerExtensions project during build and restores it with its own inline versions. Central Package Management is switched off for that generated project only.
Legacy build tooling on a non-SDK project format that cannot import Directory.Packages.props. Remove this entry when the tooling moves to an SDK-style project.
